results.title:
Meet Luis!

Luis has been grooming since 2015 and has been with Mobile Pet Shine for about a year and a half. He moved to Colorado all the way from El Paso, Texas with his three dogs; Nicolae, Teddy, and Mitzy. Even though the snow was an adjustment, he absolutely loves it here!

“I was a nurse for many years, but one day I wanted a change. I always loved animals so I started my own business mobile grooming in Texas and have been grooming since. I really love my job. This company and all my colleagues are like family to me.”

Outside of work Luis loves to camp, go hawking, and spend time with his three beautiful dogs.
